text:
Maya (People Ops): quick check 1 Hana flew to Lisbon and used ATMs, cash for coffees, and had two faded paper receipts. What's the process for small foreign cash receipts vs per diem?

Hana (Sales): I have card receipts for taxi and the hotel folio, but 2 cafe slips are illegible. Could I use per diem instead of itemizing?

Tom (Finance): yes, you can opt for per diem for that travel day. If you choose per diem you do not need individual meal receipts. If you submit actuals, any single item over  30 EUR requires a receipt. For small illegible receipts under the threshold, attach a short attestation.

Maya (People Ops): what should the attestation say?

Tom (Finance): paste this into the missing receipt note: ```I, Hana, confirm minor cash purchases occurred on 2026-03-02 in Lisbon totaling  14.20 EUR (two coffees). Receipts were illegible. Supporting documents: hotel folio and card taxi receipt attached.``` That will be sufficient for Finance review.

ExpenseBot: FYI 1 Lisbon per diem: 55 EUR/day. Per-diem covers meals and incidental VAT; do not submit VAT-only claims when using per diem. See /travel-per-diem for the country table.

Hana (Sales): if I already submitted a taxi on the company card, can I include the cash cafe charges in the same expense report?

Tom (Finance): yes, include all trip items in a single report but as separate line items: card taxi (card receipt), cash cafes (attestation or per-diem). Do not merge cafe cash into the taxi line.

Maya (People Ops): international ATM fees?

Tom (Finance): reimbursable as a separate line if you attach the bank fee statement or show the ATM charge on your card statement.

Hana (Sales): thanks 1 I'll submit per diem for that day and attach the hotel folio + taxi receipt.
